rules.title: Templates for this campaign
rules.description: New notes in {{campaign}} start from these templates. Automatic uses _templates/<type>.md when it exists, otherwise the built-in.
rules.noCampaignDescription: Open a campaign, then come back here to choose which template each note type uses.
rules.saveError: Could not save the template choice

library.empty: Select a template to view or edit it.

create.title: New template
create.description: Creates a template in _templates/ at the Codex root.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: {{path}} will be moved to the Trash. Campaigns using it go back to automatic.

campaignSections.title: Sections of this campaign
campaignSections.description: Reorder, rename, hide or delete the sections of {{campaign}}, or add your own. Deleting a section moves its folder and files to the Trash.
campaignSections.noCampaignDescription: Open a campaign, then come back here to set up its sections.

create.title: New section
create.description: A section of this campaign only, with its own folder.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: A short line shown on the overview
create.templateDescription: The template new notes of this section start from. Create more in the Templates sheet.

edit.title: Edit section
edit.description: Change the name or the icon. The folder stays as it is, so the notes keep working.

remove.title: Delete {{name}}?
remove.description: The {{folder}} folder and the {{count}} files in it go to the Trash, where you can restore them.
remove.rewriteLinks: Turn links to its files into plain text and remove their embeds

rename.title: Rename section
rename.description: Leave it empty to go back to the default name, {{name}}. The folder keeps its name.

codeMap.label: Code map
codeMap.description: A map of the whole note on the right, in the editor and in Reading view: each element in its own colour, H1–H3 as labels. Click or drag it to scroll, use the wheel over it, click a heading to jump to it.

codeMapHideShort.label: Hide the code map on short notes
codeMapHideShort.description: Leave the code map out of notes shorter than 40 lines. It needs the code map above to be on.

lineNumbers.label: Line numbers
lineNumbers.description: Show the line numbers next to the text.

readableWidth.label: Readable line width
readableWidth.description: Keep the text in a centred column instead of using the full width.

defaultView.label: Default view
defaultView.description: How a note opens the first time. Each note then remembers the view you chose.

lineWrapping.label: Line wrapping
lineWrapping.description: Wrap long lines; when off, they scroll sideways (useful for wide tables in Source).

highlightActiveLine.label: Highlight current line
highlightActiveLine.description: A faint band behind the line the cursor is on.

autoClosePairs.label: Auto-close pairs
autoClosePairs.description: Typing ( [ { " or ` also writes the closing one. Selected text is always wrapped instead.

spellcheck.label: Spellcheck
spellcheck.description: Underline misspelled words. Fantasy names will be flagged too.

showSourceView.label: Source view
showSourceView.description: Offer the Source view (raw markdown) next to Live preview and Reading.

textSize.label: Text size
textSize.description: Size of the text in the editor and in Reading view.

current.title: Open Codex
current.name: Name
current.hint: Your notes are plain .md files in this folder. Closing the Codex does not delete them.

close.title: Close this Codex?
close.description: You go back to the Codex chooser. Your notes stay in the folder and nothing is deleted.

reset.heading: Reset the app
reset.explanation: Forgets the open Codex and this device’s settings (theme, language, editor, saved layouts) and starts the app again from scratch. The Codex folder and your notes are not touched.
reset.title: Reset the app?
reset.description: The open Codex and all settings of this device are forgotten. Your notes stay in their folder and nothing is deleted.

setup.title: Pick your Codex
setup.description: A Codex is the folder that holds all your campaigns as Markdown files. LazyDM only adds a small configuration file to it. Choose a new or an existing folder.

existing.label: Existing Codex
existing.description: This folder already contains a LazyDM Codex. It will be opened as it is.

empty.label: New Codex
empty.description: The folder is empty. A new Codex will be created here.

nonEmpty.label: New Codex
nonEmpty.description: This folder already has files. LazyDM will add its configuration and leave your files untouched.

errors.desktopOnly: A Codex can only be opened in the LazyDM desktop app.
errors.missing: The Codex at {{path}} can't be reached. It may have been moved or deleted, or its cloud drive isn't available yet.
errors.readOnly: LazyDM can't write to this folder. Choose a folder you can edit.

sync.overlayDescription: {{provider}} is downloading notes that changed on your other devices. LazyDM opens the Codex as soon as they are on this device.
sync.pendingDescription: {{count}} notes are not on this device yet. They will appear as soon as {{provider}} downloads them.
sync.conflictsDescription: Your cloud service created copies of notes edited on two devices at the same time. Review them and delete the copy you don't need:

list.title: Campaigns
list.emptyDescription: A campaign is a folder in your Codex with scenes, characters, enemies, encounters and sessions. Create your first one to start preparing.

create.title: New campaign
create.description: LazyDM creates a folder for the campaign in your Codex. Choose the sections it starts with.
create.nameDescription: The folder is named after it, with dashes instead of spaces.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: A short summary of the adventure
create.presetsDescription: Assets and Encounters are always included. You can add, change or delete sections later.

newNote.title: New note
newNote.exists: A note with this name already exists in this folder. Choose another title.

scenes.description: Events and moments to run at the table.

enemies.description: Foes, their stat blocks and tactics.

encounters.description: Combats and challenges, ready to run.

handouts.description: Letters, clues and texts to give to the players.

sessions.description: Prep and recaps of each session.

notes.description: Notes without a section of their own.

template.label: Template
template.ariaLabel: Template for new notes in this section

newFolder.title: New folder
newFolder.description: A sub-folder of {{section}} to organise its notes. One level only.
newFolder.specialDescription: A sub-folder of {{section}} to organise its files. One level only.

move.description: The file keeps its name; links to it are updated.

maps.description: Interactive maps with pins, paths and notes.

remove.description: {{folder}} and the {{count}} files in it will be moved to the Trash, and the settings of this campaign are forgotten.

newAnything.title: New note
newAnything.description: Pick the section it belongs to. Any section works as a starting point.

links.noLinkedFiles: No links to or from other files yet.

actions.createDescription: A new note for “{{link}}”: the link will point to it.

list.title: Compendium
list.description: Material shared by every campaign. Copy notes and files here from a campaign, or create them directly, and copy them back into any campaign.
list.emptyDescription: Create a system — a shared folder for a game, a setting or anything you reuse across campaigns.

create.description: LazyDM creates a folder in the compendium of your Codex. Its folders appear as you add notes and files.
create.nameDescription: The folder is named after it, with dashes instead of spaces.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: {{path}} and the {{count}} files in it will be moved to the Trash. Campaigns are not affected.

system.description: Shared material: copy notes and files here from a campaign, or create them directly.
system.emptyDescription: Create a note, or use “Copy to compendium” on a note or file of a campaign. Folders appear as you add things.

welcome.lead: Made by a Dungeon Master for Dungeon Masters, lazy by design: less prep, and everything at hand when the session starts.

prepare.title: Prepare once
prepare.text: Scenes, enemies, places and maps live together and link to each other.

session.title: Run it at the table
session.text: Initiative, HP and maps sit next to your notes, so you never leave the game to look something up.

files.title: Plain files you own
files.text: Everything is Markdown in a folder of your choice. No account, no lock-in.

vault.where: It can live on this device, or in a cloud folder (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box or Google Drive) to use it on more devices.
vault.cloudNote: In a cloud folder your cloud app does the syncing. LazyDM waits for pending downloads at start and warns you if two devices changed the same note.
